name: joal
description: JOAL is not designed to help or encourage you downloading illegal materials ! You must respect the law applicable in your country. I couldn't be held responsible for illegal activities performed by your usage of JOAL. How to access to WebUI : Once joal is started head to: http://IP:PORT/SECRET_OBFUSCATION_PATH/ui/. SECRET_OBFUSCATION_PATH has default value : "joaleeS8efie". This must contains only alphanumeric characters (no slash, backslash, or any other non-alphanum char)

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: This variable is not mandatory and specifies the timezone to be configured within the container. It has default value Europe/Brussels.

variables.name: Path prefix
variables.description: Once joal is started head to: http://localhost:port/SECRET_OBFUSCATION_PATH/ui/. It has default value joaleeS8efie. This must contains only alphanumeric characters (no slash, backslash, or any other non-alphanum char)

variables.name: Secret TOKEN
variables.description: Secret token here (this is some kind of a password, choose a complicated one). It has default value eikoogei8yohphaph6eiza3EraaChav2jee8lood9iegaing

variables.name: Port Joal
variables.description: This variable is not mandatory and specifies on which port joal should listen. It has default value 3965.

variables.name: Auto Upgrade
variables.description: This variable is not mandatory and specifies if the container has to launch software update at startup or not. Valid values are 0 and 1. It has default value 0.
